main.summary: Observer for binary standard output and error from a CliWrap Command.

field.name: OnStarted
field.summary: Callback invoked when the command starts, receiving the command execution cancellation token.

field.name: OnStdOut
field.summary: Callback invoked with a Stream for standard output and the command execution cancellation token.

field.name: OnStdErr
field.summary: Callback invoked with a Stream for standard error and the command execution cancellation token.

field.name: OnExited
field.summary: Callback invoked when the command exits, receiving the command execution cancellation token.
